Method of Attack: Scanning system hidden inside a legitimate file that queries a remote server for a list of domains to scan for Adminer script/plugins
Brute-force attacks to break into Adminer management panels with default or easy-to-guess passwords
Exploitation of past Adminer vulnerabilities to gain access to the database management interface
Impacted Systems: Websites running Adminer database management script
CMS platforms such as WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, Magento
Attack Vector: Compromised website hosting the scanning infrastructure
Remote scanning of domains for Adminer files
Brute-force attacks on Adminer login panels
Indicators of Compromise: File named 'c' storing identified Adminer sites and working URLs
